cloudSync.title: Cloud document sync
cloudSync.introTitle: Sync password entries to Tencent Docs Smartsheet or Feishu Bitable
cloudSync.introText: Encrypted snapshot backup is the default: the local vault is encrypted as a whole, split into chunks and uploaded, so the cloud content stays unreadable and can be verified and restored at any time. Switching to plaintext mode uploads usernames, passwords and other fields as readable text, so make sure the target document's access control is locked down first.
cloudSync.allowInsecure: I understand this address uses no encryption; credentials and sync data travel the network in plaintext
cloudSync.enableTip: Disabling keeps the saved credentials, target table and local snapshot; only new sync operations are stopped.
cloudSync.modeEncryptedTip: Recommended. The vault is encrypted and uploaded in chunks, so the cloud cannot read password content. Backup and manual restore only.
cloudSync.modePlaintextTip: Usernames, passwords and notes are written to the cloud table as readable text, enabling row-level two-way sync at the cost of exposure risk.
cloudSync.plaintextWarning: In plaintext mode your usernames, passwords, notes and 2FA secrets are written to a third-party cloud document as readable text. Anyone who can open that document can read them. Confirm the document's access control is tightened before continuing.
cloudSync.modeChanged: Sync mode switched. Test the connection again to adapt to the new table schema.
cloudSync.feishu.baseUrlPlaceholder: Defaults to https://open.feishu.cn; enter your self-hosted open platform URL
cloudSync.feishu.baseUrlTip: For a privately deployed Feishu/Lark instance, enter your own open platform base URL such as https://open.example.com (a gateway path prefix is allowed); leave it empty to use the official endpoint. Confirm plaintext transport below for an internal HTTP address; http://localhost is allowed for local debugging. Re-run the connection test after changing it.
cloudSync.feishu.baseUrlInvalid: Invalid API base URL. Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
cloudSync.tencent.baseUrlPlaceholder: Defaults to https://docs.qq.com; enter your self-hosted open platform URL
cloudSync.tencent.baseUrlTip: For a privately deployed Tencent Docs instance, enter your own open platform base URL such as https://docs.example.com (a gateway path prefix is allowed); leave it empty to use the official endpoint. Confirm plaintext transport below for an internal HTTP address, and re-run the connection test after changing it.
cloudSync.tencent.baseUrlInvalid: Invalid API base URL. Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
cloudSync.tencent.urlPlaceholder: Paste a Tencent Docs Smartsheet link
cloudSync.webdav.dirUrlTip: Enter the WebDAV directory URL. The extension creates an aph-backup subdirectory for encrypted backups.
cloudSync.webdav.passwordTip: For Jianguoyun, use an app password generated in security settings instead of your account password.
cloudSync.webdav.bearerTokenPlaceholder: Takes precedence over username/password when set
cloudSync.webdav.bearerTokenTip: Only for WebDAV gateways that use token auth.
cloudSync.webdav.encryptedOnly: WebDAV supports encrypted backup only: the vault is encrypted into a single unreadable file. The cloud cannot view or edit entries.
cloudSync.targetUrlTip: The file identifier is parsed from the pasted link. If the sync table does not exist yet, it is created automatically when you test the connection.
cloudSync.keepVersionsTip: Every backup creates a new encrypted version; older versions beyond the retention count are cleaned up after the backup completes.
cloudSync.tableCreated: The sync table was created and configured automatically.
cloudSync.emptyLocalDeleteTitle: Delete the online user list table?
cloudSync.emptyLocalDeleteConfirm: The local account list is empty. Continuing will delete every account and password from the online user list table. This cannot be undone.
cloudSync.verifyPrompt: Cloud sync needs access to your local password data. Enter the master password to continue.
cloudSync.restoreConfirm: Restore reads the latest encrypted snapshot from the cloud and merges it into this device. Newer local entries are never overwritten, and no local data is deleted.
cloudSync.clearVersionsConfirm: Encrypted versions beyond the retention count will be deleted from the cloud, keeping only the latest one. This does not affect local data and cannot be undone.
cloudSync.clearAuditConfirm: The audit log only contains non-sensitive fields such as action type, time and error codes. Clearing it cannot be undone.
cloudSync.credentialIncomplete: Fill in the complete credentials for the current provider first.
cloudSync.urlRequired: Enter the target document link first.
cloudSync.cancelled: Operation cancelled. Batches that already completed were kept.
cloudSync.auditClearFailed: Failed to clear the audit log. Try again later.
cloudSync.loadFailed: Failed to load cloud sync settings.
cloudSync.saveFailed: Failed to save cloud sync settings.
cloudSync.report.title: Sync report
cloudSync.report.restoreSummary: Restore result: {added} added, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped, {rejected} rejected.
cloudSync.warning.manualConflict: A conflict needing manual review was detected (reason: {reason}) and was not merged automatically.
cloudSync.warning.insecureTransport: The cloud sync address does not use HTTPS; credentials and sync data travel in plaintext. Switch to encrypted transport if possible.
cloudSync.warning.snapshotDegraded: The local snapshot is missing or damaged, so this run fell back to a full comparison. Rebuild the snapshot after syncing.
cloudSync.warning.auditLogFailed: The audit log could not be written, so this sync result was not recorded.
cloudSync.error.invalidCredential: The credential is invalid or expired. Regenerate it on the platform and fill it in again.
cloudSync.error.permission: The app has no permission to access this document. Check the document's sharing settings.
cloudSync.error.notFound: The target document or data table was not found. Check that the link is correct.
cloudSync.error.schema: The cloud table schema was modified externally. Delete that table and test the connection again.
cloudSync.error.tooLarge: Cell content exceeds the platform limit. Try lowering the chunk size.
cloudSync.error.rateLimit: Too many requests; the platform is rate limiting. Try again later.
cloudSync.error.writeConflict: The same table is being written by another sync task or device. Try again later.
cloudSync.error.quota: The cloud quota or capacity is exceeded. Clean up and try again.
cloudSync.error.network: The network request failed. Check your connection and try again.
cloudSync.error.unknown: The operation failed. Check the failure details in the sync report.
